title: ws-presence-update (both directions)

run_id.description: App to server only, and only with state in_game: the run being played. The server counts play time per run when the user joined that run with this game, otherwise it ignores it. Never broadcast.

display_name.description: Server to apps: display name of the user (together_v1).

game_title.description: Server to apps, only with state in_game: title of the game; omitted when unknown or when the receiving user may not see the game.

system.description: Server to apps, only with game_title: system id of the game.

session_id.description: App to server: optional and ignored (the server derives the Session of the device). Server to apps: the active Session shared by this device, only for receivers the Session ACL allows (private: owner's devices; invite_only: invited users; hub_users: everyone); omitted otherwise.

description: App to server: {state: online|in_game, game_id?, run_id?, session_id?}. Server to apps: additionally user_id and device_id (always set), display_name, state may be offline; with state in_game also game_title and system (when the receiver may see the game); session_id only for receivers the Session ACL allows (together_v1); run_id is never sent to other apps.
